nodes.label: WorkflowHub 可信度恢复 — 规格 (spec.md)
Skill closure consistency (bundle/catalog/release/resolver)
nodes.rationale: D-005: the current problem is hash/closure drift, not a missing second release system, so the existing bundle generator/catalog/local resolver/closure checker are reused as the single closure owner and only contract tests plus negative cases are added; a second bundle truth, manual hash updater or replacement catalog is explicitly rejected.

nodes.label: Single canonical quality writer (stage-runtime/TaskKernel)
nodes.rationale: D-006: multiple writers let the same fact be overwritten or forked, destroying immutable lineage; therefore all non-stage-runtime writes to the current quality namespace must be explicitly rejected with a zero current-quality delta, while legacy reads and isolated fixtures move to non-current paths instead of a permanent double-write compatibility bridge.

nodes.label: Narrow bridge outcome contract
nodes.rationale: The bridge must not copy stage-completion logic or own the quality namespace: it may only carry schema_version/task_id/stage/attempt_id/outcome_ref/outcome_sha256/outcome_status/producer, and every illegal lifecycle case (out-of-order, duplicate, time overlap or clock rollback, missing package, identity mismatch) returns a deterministic failed/unavailable with zero current-quality delta.

nodes.label: Broker-provenance wh-review layering (dsh = diagnostic only)
nodes.rationale: D-004: a local/self review has no foreign provenance, so it cannot satisfy a formal quality conclusion; only a canonical broker-provenance wh-review bound to the current snapshot/material/review-track may enter verify-code.code_review, and dsh-code-review results stay diagnostic inputs. Provider unavailability stays unavailable rather than becoming empty findings.

nodes.label: Legacy evidence read-only boundary
nodes.rationale: G-001: 'old evidence may be displayed' and 'old evidence may complete' are different claims; display is read-only while current completion consumes only current hash/snapshot/quality facts. Old records are never auto-rebound, written back or substituted for current review/AC/human confirmation.

nodes.label: SnapshotIdentity (task/stage/HEAD/clean/material revision)
nodes.rationale: D-003: dirty, mutable content cannot be re-verified by anyone else, so only a clean, committed, locatable snapshot plus the current material revision can produce formal stage facts; dirty worktrees yield local diagnostics only, and mis-binding must fail loud instead of silently rebinding to HEAD.

nodes.label: Current completion truth table and aggregate priority
nodes.rationale: D-007: completion predicates need current facts, so legacy or missing facts cannot satisfy them; the fixed aggregation order is snapshot/material/provenance -> required step/skill -> review and finding disposition -> stage-specific predicate -> handoff, and no later status may override an earlier failure. Required skills/steps must be completed, not_applicable requires trigger=false and executed=false, and unavailable/unknown/incomplete are preserved as-is.

nodes.label: FindingDisposition (fixed or accepted_risk binding)
nodes.rationale: D-008: an unresolved serious finding makes the completion claim untrustworthy, so actionable major/blocking findings must be fixed with same-snapshot evidence or carry an accepted risk bound to that exact finding, with real user confirmation, owner, time and scope; the original verdict is never rewritten and risk acceptance is not a reviewer pass.

nodes.label: Stable idempotency key, replay conflict and partial-write contract
nodes.rationale: Retries, duplicates and replays must not create a second canonical fact: the key is SHA-256 over the canonical narrow-outcome fields, same key plus same bytes replays to the same reference with zero delta, a byte conflict fails as BRIDGE_REPLAY_CONFLICT, and an interrupted partial write may only be recovered atomically under the same key or stay incomplete/unknown.
